what: The take film v3, the film on the landing page, is cut from, 2026-11-13: the phone page of https://undo-btc.pages.dev on a real phone, and the thief tab of the same site in headless Chrome on a Mac, a second device, opened from the thief link the phone page copied and clicked by the capture script; against the NEAR testnet contract below and Mutinynet. Every hash and number under vault, coin, thief, cancel, assertion_as_read and chain_read was read from the chains: the NEAR testnet transactions from archival RPC and the coin from the Mutinynet API. Which device and browser held the passkey, and how it verified its user, no chain shows: device_as_reported is the author's report, not the chain's: an iPhone, in Safari, with Face ID. The film's phone shots are the iPhone's own screen recording; the file says it is an iOS screen recording, and it shows the passkey sheet and the Face ID glyph. No execute after the wait is recorded for this take. The passkey's credential id is left out: no chain holds it. This record never held the vault's spend key, the thief link or any secret.

clock_readings.how: Clock readings from F 23 to 28 only (T 20-25 s since the theft; 150 thief and 150 phone frames), least squares over each frame's reading + its capture time (thief: the CDP time of the screencast frame shown; phone: the raw recording time of the frame shown). Both pages round the remaining time up to 0.1 s, so the rounding bias cancels.
clock_readings.thief_clock: one constant clock all take (+-0.016 s)

sync.definition: phone.mp4 seconds minus thief CDP seconds at the same instant (phone_s = cdp_s + offset_s)
sync.residual_note: RMS of the one-offset fit over the window. It is over 0.1 s because the PHONE page's clock stepped by -0.341 s at phone 117.0 s (T 21.80), inside the window (its SkewTracker took a fresher chain-time sample). Each side of the step alone fits to 0.03 s RMS (thief: one constant clock for the whole take, +-0.016 s).

independent_check.note: the iPhone file's own date (ReplayKit, ms precision) put frame 0 within 0.007 s of where the clock sync puts it, if that date marks the first frame; thief CDP times are this Mac's wall clock

sync.t2: residual over 0.1 s by the letter; accepted by the lead on 2026-11-14: the chip equals floor(T) on every running frame of every cut, and the frozen 0:41 is at T 41.209 by the sync and 41.216 by the iPhone file's own date
